admission.justification: The alternative of letting the worktree start resolve the sprint hint was seriously considered and rejected because it is the refusing mismatch; the choice binds how every later start reads the recorded edge.

alternatives.option: Read the master's recorded series-contract parent and pass it; use the commanding sprint only when no contract exists yet.
alternatives.reason: The worktree start admits the contract's recorded edge, and the first start bootstraps it as before.

alternatives.option: Keep passing the sprint folder name and let the worktree start resolve it.
alternatives.reason: That is exactly the mismatch that refused the first starts.
alternatives.reconsider_when: Series contracts start recording a different parent name.

alternatives.option: Rewrite or replace the master's series contract at launch.
alternatives.reason: A launch may not replace an owner-admitted contract edge; the worktree start's checks stay as they are.
alternatives.reconsider_when: The developer rules a different owner for the series-contract edge.

consequences: The start reads the recorded contract parent, the first start still creates a missing contract, and every later start reads what the first recorded; no second preparation route is built.
context: A leaf role's first start passed the commanding sprint's folder name as the worktree parent hint, while this master's series contract records the master's own name; the first start was refused with an edge mismatch and the refusal named no remedy.
decider: packet MIK-R95@v1 rule 5 and its open truth gap; developer direction D88 / MIK-R100 for the seat set
